pois.name: Karlsruhe Palace
pois.description: Baroque palace begun in 1715. The fan-shaped street grid of Karlsruhe radiates from its tower.

pois.name: Palace Square
pois.description: Wide open square south of the palace where the fan of streets begins.

pois.name: Market Square
pois.description: Central square on Kaiserstrasse with the sandstone Pyramid, tomb of city founder Margrave Karl Wilhelm.

pois.name: Protestant City Church
pois.description: Classicist church by Friedrich Weinbrenner on the east side of the Market Square.

pois.name: Federal Constitutional Court
pois.description: Seat of the Federal Constitutional Court of Germany, next to the palace grounds.

pois.name: Botanical Garden
pois.description: Historic botanical garden with greenhouses at the western edge of the palace grounds.

pois.name: State Art Gallery
pois.description: Staatliche Kunsthalle, a major art museum next to the Botanical Garden.

pois.name: Kronenplatz
pois.description: Square at the eastern part of the Kaiserstrasse shopping street with a busy tram stop.

pois.name: Friedrichsplatz
pois.description: Small park square south of the Market Square, framed by the natural history museum.
